name: agents
description: A framework for building realtime voice AI agents 🤖🎙️📹
one_liner: A toolkit for building AI agents that can have real-time voice or video conversations with people, like a phone-call assistant.
buyer: A business owner who wants an AI phone agent to answer calls — booking, support, sales — without hiring staff.
business_use_cases: A dental or salon chain builds an AI phone agent that books appointments 24/7 without a receptionist.
A support-heavy SaaS builds a voice-AI tier for customers who prefer calling over chatting.
An agency white-labels voice agents for local businesses (restaurants, clinics) as a monthly service.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell an industry-specific AI phone receptionist (e.g. for dental clinics) as a monthly subscription.
Charge per-minute usage fees for a white-labeled voice-agent platform built on this framework.

steal_this: Build a simple AI phone-booking agent for one local business type (salons, restaurants) this weekend and sell it as a $99/mo service.
